arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_pin_transactions FROM transactions WHERE errors = 'Bad PIN'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose error is recorded as 'Bad PIN', across the whole data period, whether or not they have a fraud label.
assumptions: Counted transactions whose errors value is exactly 'Bad PIN'. If a transaction can hold more than one error in that field, any that combine 'Bad PIN' with another error are left out.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
Took 'failed with a bad pin error' to mean the transaction has the 'Bad PIN' error. The data doesn't say whether the transaction was actually declined.
